stem.text: A nucleus of carbon-10, ${}^{10}_{6}\text{C}$, decays by beta-emission to form a nucleus of boron-10, ${}^{10}_{5}\text{B}$.
For this decay process, what is the change to a nucleon and what is the change in the quark composition of the nucleon?

A.text: proton to neutron; down becomes up

B.text: proton to neutron; up becomes down

C.text: neutron to proton; down becomes up

D.text: neutron to proton; up becomes down
